dependency_partition.rule: A frozen signal configuration is NON_SESSION_SAFE iff its filters object does not contain the SESSION family.
dependency_partition.config_id_preservation: CONFIG_ID remains SHA256 of the original frozen canonical configuration bytes; removing SESSION configs from rematerialization does not renumber or rewrite any surviving CONFIG_ID.

mask_semantics.safe_rematerialization: Generate masks only for original frozen configs without SESSION. No filter, threshold, base tuple or execution rule is changed.
mask_semantics.class_identity: Domain-qualified class_hash remains SHA256(domain_bytes || NUL || ordered uint64 source-record indices).
mask_semantics.representative: For economic safe subset, representative is the lexicographically smallest NON_SESSION_SAFE CONFIG_ID in that exact mask class. This does not transfer promotion to SESSION aliases.
mask_semantics.session_aliases: SESSION-dependent aliases remain QUARANTINED even when their DEV mask is byte-identical to a safe alias.

multiplicity.m_for_BY: Use the full frozen distinct_mask_class_count of the completed shard, not the number of rematerialized safe classes.
multiplicity.quarantined_missing_classes: For calculation only, unresolved session-only hypotheses occupy the unrecycled hypothesis budget and are equivalent to non-rejectable p=1 entries; they are NOT scientifically rejected.
multiplicity.safe_class_rank: All safe raw p<1 sort before the synthetic p=1 quarantine mass, so their BY ranks are exactly their ranks among safe classes while denominator remains m_full * H_m_full.

decision_semantics.safe_survivor: May advance only if the frozen first-gate requirements pass using full-shard m and the original anchor execution.
decision_semantics.safe_failure: May be rejected by the frozen gate.
decision_semantics.session_only_or_session_alias: QUARANTINED_NO_TERMINAL_DECISION until provenance dependency is resolved.
decision_semantics.shard_terminal_status: A shard may report completed safe-subset Gate A plus quarantined session dependency; it is not a full global-data promotion.
